annotation.interpretation_a: An endpoint is permitted to discard invalid Initial packets, but is not required to.
annotation.interpretation_b: An endpoint is required to discard invalid Initial packets.
annotation.justification: The use of 'MAY' is ambiguous. It could mean the endpoint is permitted to discard, or that it is required to discard. This difference in interpretation affects implementation.
annotation.missing_information: The specification does not clarify whether 'MAY' indicates permission or obligation in this context. This affects implementation because some endpoints might choose to always discard, while others might attempt further processing or error handling before discarding.
